narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Nine ninety nine is the largest, so it is the answer for thirty presses.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Its digits add up to twenty seven, so the fewest presses are twenty seven.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Twenty seven is not thirty, and a trade would add nine, so that slip is struck out.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble appears with 999; 9 + 9 + 9 = 27 is written; the slip is struck through

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>The count of presses moves up in steps of nine from the digit sum.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>We choose a digit sum that is nine less, eighteen less or twenty seven less than the target.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Which is the largest three digit number made with exactly twenty five presses?
